notes: Very long text (413K characters, 299 articles + 32 transitory articles); both versions were annotated in three parts and merged. Systematic sampling: X events k=3 (36 of 106), thresholds k=2 (26 of 52), obligations k=7 (36 of 249), enforcement all 38; Y events k=3 (33 of 98), thresholds k=2 (23 of 46), obligations k=7 (39 of 270), enforcement all 34. Reference list restricted to operative cutoffs, key dates and Title XIV sanctions (see reference_note in the reference file). Both versions code Art. 10 (and Art. 115, 76, 98) competence or cross-reference clauses as separate sanction rows; judged duplicate of the Title XIV regime rows by the same rule in both. Y cites many obligations with a quote in the provision field instead of an article number (from index ~180 onward); content judged on its merits. X records the Art. 284 recidivism doubling inside the Art. 282 rows; Y as its own row. X misses the Art. 287 XIV revocation cutoffs (>50% coverage, >24 h / 3 days); Y misses the Art. 267 below-50% plan cutoff and does not code the Art. 208 IV / 209 XI precautionary suspensions.
